context.title: EMILYs List — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements (California picks only)

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 48

positions.statement: "Marni is running for California’s 48th Congressional District — one of the most competitive seats in the country and under the new maps in California. For years, Republican Rep. Darrell Issa has put special interests, extremists, and partisan politics ahead of Southern California. With her record of flipping tough districts and fighting for working families, Marni is the battle-tested leader who can win this seat and make Washington work for everyday Californians. She’ll take on rising costs, defend reproductive freedom, protect LGBTQ+ rights, and ensure that San Diego’s families have a voice that truly represents them. EMILYs List is proud to stand with her in the critical election and take back the U.S. House."
